highlights.text: Flux Streaming is an app of its own: streaming to Moonlight, AirPlay and Miracast moved out of Flux Titan Hub, with their own updates and About page. Your pairings come along from Flux Keyboard once it's updated, so Moonlight needn't pair again. Your games and their art come from Flux Gaming, the Linux desktop from Flux Desktop, and the volume keys are the TV's while it plays there.
